title: The Colors of India
description: India is the most colorful country on Earth — from spice markets to silk saris to color-drenched festivals. #india #colors #culture #incredibleindia

scenes.text: India might be the most colorful country on Earth.
Markets overflowing with mountains of spices.
Silk saris in every shade you can imagine.
Trucks, walls, and streets painted like living art.
And festivals where the very air turns to color.
In India, color isn't decoration. It's a language.
